en.greeting: Hi! Today you'll learn to tell someone about your normal day, step by step and with times. Let's start.

steps.title: Your day in English
steps.text: Let's start with the words for a normal day. You already know the grammar: it's the simple present.
steps.body: A **routine** is what you do (almost) every day. Most routine words are **chunks**: small groups of words you learn together. **have** breakfast / lunch / dinner: here *have* = makan, not punya. **go home** = pulang, with **no** *to*; but go **to** work, go **to** bed. With he/she, only the first word takes -s: she **gets** up, he **has** breakfast, she **goes** home.

steps.title: First, then, after that
steps.text: Now let's put your day in order. English uses small order words to show what comes first and what comes next.
steps.body: Start each sentence with an order word: **First** (the first thing), **Then**, **After that**, **Finally** (the last thing). Use *then* and *after that* in turns so you don't repeat one word. A comma after *First, After that* and *Finally* is common; after *Then* usually not. To join two actions of one person, use **and** (or **and then**).

steps.title: Rina's morning, in order
steps.text: Rina works at a bank in Jakarta. Here's her morning. Look at the order words at the start.
steps.body: In *I have a shower and get dressed* there's one person and two actions: say **I** once and join with **and**. Don't add am/is/are before an action word: 'and I am get dressed' is wrong.

examples.en: First, I get up at five.
examples.id: Pertama-tama, saya bangun jam lima.

examples.en: Then I have a shower and get dressed.
examples.id: Lalu saya mandi dan berpakaian.

examples.en: After that, I have breakfast with my family.
examples.id: Setelah itu, saya sarapan bersama keluarga.

examples.en: Then I go to work by train.
examples.id: Lalu saya berangkat kerja naik kereta.

examples.en: Finally, I start work at eight.
examples.id: Terakhir, saya mulai kerja jam delapan.

steps.title: Build a sentence
steps.text: What does Budi do after breakfast? Build a sentence about him.

question.prompt: Arrange the words: Budi naik bus ke kantor.
question.solution: Budi takes the bus to work.
question.explanation: Normal order: person (**Budi**) + action (**takes the bus**) + where (**to work**). Budi is one other person (he), so the action word gets **-s**: take → **takes**.

steps.title: Your turn
steps.text: One person, two actions. Which sentence is right?

question.prompt: Dimas finishes work at five. Choose the correct sentence.
options: He goes home and is cook dinner.
He goes home and cooks dinner.
He goes home and cook dinner.
question.explanation: **cook** is an action word, so there's no *is* before it. And it's still Dimas (he), so the second action takes **-s** too: goes … and **cooks**.

steps.title: Saying when
steps.text: Now let's say *when* you do things. You met these small words before; here they are for your day.
steps.body: **at** + a clock time: *at six*. **in the** morning / afternoon / evening, but **at night** (just remember it). **on** + a day: *on Saturdays* (= every Saturday). **every** day / morning: **no** at/on/in before *every*. Careful: *setengah enam* is 5:30 = **half past five**, not 'half past six': English counts from the hour that has passed.

steps.title: Time words in real sentences
steps.text: See where the time words go: usually at the end, or at the start to set the scene.
steps.body: With a clock time and a part of the day, say the clock time first: *at six in the morning*, the same order as *jam enam pagi*. And *19.00* is **seven p.m.** or **seven in the evening**, not 'nineteen'.

examples.en: Pak Hasan opens his warung at six in the morning.
examples.id: Pak Hasan membuka warungnya jam enam pagi.

examples.en: We have dinner at seven in the evening.
examples.id: Kami makan malam jam tujuh malam.

examples.en: Bu Ani works from eight to four.
examples.id: Bu Ani bekerja dari jam delapan sampai jam empat.

examples.en: In the afternoon, the children play football.
examples.id: Siang/sore hari, anak-anak bermain sepak bola.

examples.en: My parents visit us on Saturdays.
examples.id: Orang tua saya mengunjungi kami setiap hari Sabtu.

steps.title: Careful with setengah
steps.text: Dewi tells you when she starts work. Watch the *setengah* trap!

question.prompt: Dewi says: 'Saya mulai kerja jam setengah delapan.' Complete: I start work ___.
question.explanation: *Setengah delapan* is 7:30. English counts from the hour that has passed: **half past seven**. A clock time takes **at**, not *on*.

steps.title: Your turn
steps.text: Night work is a little different. Choose the right time words.

question.prompt: Pak Joko sleeps in the morning. Complete: He works ___.
question.explanation: Parts of the day take *in the* (in the morning, in the evening), but night is the exception: **at night**. Remember it as one chunk.

steps.title: Quick review
steps.text: Flip through these cards to remember the order words and time words.

steps.title: Cheat sheet
steps.text: Here's your day on one page. Keep it for later.

artifact.title: Cheat sheet · Describing your day

at six, at half past five
The street is quiet at night.
tips: One person, two actions: join with **and** and don't add am/is/are: *I wake up and pray*, not 'and I am pray'. With he/she both actions take -s.
*Setengah enam* = 5:30 = **half past five**: take one hour less than the Indonesian number.
**go home** has no *to*; **at night** but **in the** morning/evening; no at/on/in before **every**.

examples.en: I usually get up at six in the morning.
examples.id: Saya biasanya bangun jam enam pagi.

examples.en: After that, she goes to work by ojek.
examples.id: Setelah itu, dia berangkat kerja naik ojek.

examples.en: We watch TV in the evening.
examples.id: Kami menonton TV malam hari.

steps.text: Want more practice? This page has routine words, order words and time words with online exercises.

id.greeting: Halo! Hari ini kamu belajar menceritakan hari biasamu kepada orang lain, langkah demi langkah dan lengkap dengan jamnya. Yuk, mulai.

steps.title: Harimu dalam bahasa Inggris
steps.text: Kita mulai dari kata-kata untuk hari biasa. Tata bahasanya sudah kamu tahu: simple present.
steps.body: **Rutinitas** (routine) adalah hal yang kamu lakukan (hampir) setiap hari. Kebanyakan kata rutinitas adalah **chunk**: kelompok kecil kata yang dipelajari bersama. **have** breakfast / lunch / dinner: di sini *have* = makan, bukan punya. **go home** = pulang, **tanpa** *to*; tapi go **to** work, go **to** bed. Dengan he/she, hanya kata pertama yang mendapat -s: she **gets** up, he **has** breakfast, she **goes** home.

steps.title: First, then, after that
steps.text: Sekarang kita urutkan harimu. Bahasa Inggris memakai kata urutan kecil untuk menunjukkan apa yang pertama dan apa yang berikutnya.
steps.body: Mulai tiap kalimat dengan kata urutan: **First** (yang pertama), **Then** (lalu), **After that** (setelah itu), **Finally** (yang terakhir). Pakai *then* dan *after that* bergantian supaya tidak mengulang satu kata. Koma setelah *First, After that* dan *Finally* itu biasa; setelah *Then* biasanya tidak. Untuk menyambung dua kegiatan satu orang, pakai **and** (atau **and then**).

steps.title: Pagi Rina, secara berurutan
steps.text: Rina bekerja di bank di Jakarta. Ini pagi harinya. Perhatikan kata urutan di awal kalimat.
steps.body: Di *I have a shower and get dressed* ada satu orang dan dua kegiatan: sebut **I** sekali saja lalu sambung dengan **and**. Jangan tambahkan am/is/are sebelum kata kegiatan: 'and I am get dressed' itu salah.

examples.en: First, I get up at five.
examples.id: Pertama-tama, saya bangun jam lima.

examples.en: Then I have a shower and get dressed.
examples.id: Lalu saya mandi dan berpakaian.

examples.en: After that, I have breakfast with my family.
examples.id: Setelah itu, saya sarapan bersama keluarga.

examples.en: Then I go to work by train.
examples.id: Lalu saya berangkat kerja naik kereta.

examples.en: Finally, I start work at eight.
examples.id: Terakhir, saya mulai kerja jam delapan.

steps.title: Susun kalimatnya
steps.text: Apa yang Budi lakukan setelah sarapan? Susun kalimat tentang dia.

question.prompt: Susun kata-katanya: Budi naik bus ke kantor.
question.solution: Budi takes the bus to work.
question.explanation: Urutan biasa: orang (**Budi**) + kegiatan (**takes the bus**) + tujuan (**to work**). Budi itu satu orang lain (he), jadi kata kegiatannya dapat **-s**: take → **takes**.

steps.title: Giliranmu
steps.text: Satu orang, dua kegiatan. Kalimat mana yang benar?

question.prompt: Dimas selesai kerja jam lima. Pilih kalimat yang benar.
options: He goes home and is cook dinner.
He goes home and cooks dinner.
He goes home and cook dinner.
question.explanation: **cook** adalah kata kegiatan, jadi tidak ada *is* sebelumnya. Dan orangnya tetap Dimas (he), jadi kegiatan kedua juga mendapat **-s**: goes … and **cooks**.

steps.title: Menyebut waktu
steps.text: Sekarang kita sebut *kapan* kamu melakukannya. Kata-kata kecil ini sudah pernah kamu temui; ini cara memakainya untuk harimu.
steps.body: **at** + jam: *at six*. **in the** morning / afternoon / evening, tapi **at night** (hafalkan saja). **on** + nama hari: *on Saturdays* (= setiap Sabtu). **every** day / morning: **tidak ada** at/on/in sebelum *every*. Hati-hati: *setengah enam* itu 5:30 = **half past five**, bukan 'half past six': bahasa Inggris menghitung dari jam yang sudah lewat.

steps.title: Keterangan waktu dalam kalimat
steps.text: Lihat letak keterangan waktunya: biasanya di akhir, atau di awal untuk membuka cerita.
steps.body: Kalau ada jam dan bagian hari, sebut jamnya dulu: *at six in the morning*, urutannya sama dengan *jam enam pagi*. Dan *19.00* adalah **seven p.m.** atau **seven in the evening**, bukan 'nineteen'.

examples.en: Pak Hasan opens his warung at six in the morning.
examples.id: Pak Hasan membuka warungnya jam enam pagi.

examples.en: We have dinner at seven in the evening.
examples.id: Kami makan malam jam tujuh malam.

examples.en: Bu Ani works from eight to four.
examples.id: Bu Ani bekerja dari jam delapan sampai jam empat.

examples.en: In the afternoon, the children play football.
examples.id: Siang/sore hari, anak-anak bermain sepak bola.

examples.en: My parents visit us on Saturdays.
examples.id: Orang tua saya mengunjungi kami setiap hari Sabtu.

steps.title: Hati-hati dengan setengah
steps.text: Dewi memberi tahu jam berapa dia mulai kerja. Awas jebakan *setengah*!

question.prompt: Dewi bilang: 'Saya mulai kerja jam setengah delapan.' Lengkapi: I start work ___.
question.explanation: *Setengah delapan* itu 7:30. Bahasa Inggris menghitung dari jam yang sudah lewat: **half past seven**. Jam memakai **at**, bukan *on*.

steps.title: Giliranmu
steps.text: Kerja malam sedikit berbeda. Pilih keterangan waktu yang tepat.

question.prompt: Pak Joko tidur pagi hari. Lengkapi: He works ___.
question.explanation: Bagian hari memakai *in the* (in the morning, in the evening), tapi night itu pengecualian: **at night**. Hafalkan sebagai satu chunk.

steps.title: Ulasan cepat
steps.text: Balik kartu-kartu ini supaya kata urutan dan keterangan waktunya makin nempel.
